t: You're looking at the building that now houses the Nationwide Anglia Building Society. It was designed by George John Vulliamy, a Victorian architect with a wide range of work. He designed buildings in Victoria Street, several fire-brigade stations, and the pedestal and sphinxes for Cleopatra's Needle on the Embankment. He also designed the sturgeon lamp posts that line the Thames Embankment, so if you walk down to the river you can see more of his work.
